hypothesis: Under isotropic tangential jitter of the icosphere at fixed vertex count, worse triangle quality comes with larger curvature error; within the latitude-longitude family and across families quality metrics do not order the errors pairwise (and the barycentric estimator's cross-family ranking reverses with the mixed Voronoi area); the maximum radius ratio is positively rank-correlated with the Voronoi-area curvature and geodesic errors over the pooled meshes, an association carried by the jitter family that vanishes within the latitude-longitude family; the dihedral fold check is neither necessary nor sufficient for an inverted face; Hausdorff convergence does not imply convergence of area, distances, normals or mean curvature.
input_data: icosphere level 3 (642 vertices), tangential jitter 0-0.3 h, 3 seeds (the same three noise fields scaled to each amplitude)
fold rates: jitter 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3 h with 60 further seeds each (20261939-20261998)
latitude-longitude spheres with 642 vertices (20x32, 10x64, 40x16, 20x32 twisted by 0.08 and 0.16 rad per ring)
Schwarz lanterns q=0.25, n=4..64; q=1, n=8
mathematical_model: Quality: minimum angle and radius ratio R_circ / (2 r_in). Curvature: angle defect over the barycentric area A/3 or the mixed Voronoi area. Schwarz lantern with m = q n^2 bands: face height sqrt((H/m)^2 + R^2 (1 - cos(pi/n))^2), so area and developed height tend to sqrt(1 + (pi^2 q R / 2H)^2) times their cylinder values while d_H = R (1 - cos(pi/n)) -> 0.
numerical_result: Jitter (seed-averaged, valid meshes): curvature RMS 0.0204@0, 0.0225@0.05, 0.0333@0.1, 0.0607@0.15; for the declared seeds 6 of 16 jittered meshes are refused, and the dihedral fold refusals coincide with inverted faces mesh by mesh. Over 60 further seeds per amplitude (inverted and accepted by the dihedral check / inverted and refused / no inverted face): 0/0/60@0.1, 1/1/58@0.15, 7/32/21@0.2, 0/60/0@0.3; 0 meshes without an inverted face are refused. Inversion missed by the dihedral check: seed 20261944 at 0.2 h, face 854 (normal . radial -0.34, corner angles 3.7, 4.3, 172.0 deg, smallest adjacent normal dot -0.44 > -0.9), unguarded curvature RMS 0.43; with the sphere centre declared it is refused as inverted_face. Min angle vs geodesic error counterexample: icosphere-3 (54.1 deg, 0.0123) vs icosphere-3-jitter0.05-s20260939 (40.9 deg, 0.0099). uv-sphere-20x32 has min angle 10.8 deg and barycentric curvature RMS 0.0161 < 0.0204, but mixed Voronoi RMS 0.0063 > 0.0048. Within the latitude-longitude family uv-sphere-40x16 (min angle 11.1 deg, radius ratio 2.87) has larger errors than uv-sphere-10x64 (5.5 deg, 5.48). Spearman over 15 pooled valid meshes: radius ratio vs Voronoi RMS 0.825, vs geodesic error 0.789 (discordant pairs 18 and 20 of 105), vs barycentric RMS 0.275; within the latitude-longitude family 0.000 and -0.300, within the jitter family 0.915 and 0.855; min angle vs barycentric RMS -0.021, vs Voronoi RMS -0.661. Lantern (m=0.25 n^2, n=64): Hausdorff 1.20e-03, area ratio 1.5873 (limit 1.5881), traced height 1.5879, interior K 6.4e-11, normal tilt 50.967 deg (limit 50.973), total |H| exponent 2.01. Planar traces exact to 8.9e-16 for min angles down to 11.9 deg, while the max edge-graph excess moves from 0.082 (shear 0) to 0.018 (shear 1.5).
observation_model: Curvature error against K = 1, geodesic endpoint error against great circles, area error; lantern area, developed height, Hausdorff distance, normal tilt and total absolute mean curvature.

title: Quantify mesh-quality effects.
uncertainty: Deterministic given the seeds; with three seeds per amplitude the monotone trend is a seed-average (t-interval reported per finding) and a different seed set could reorder neighbouring amplitudes; the three seeds are the same noise fields scaled, so amplitudes are not independent samples. Fold rates are counts over 60 seeds per amplitude (binomial 95% half-widths per finding). Rank correlations over 15 meshes have a standard error near 0.3, and the permutation p-value treats the pooled meshes as exchangeable, which the replicated noise fields and the two families are not.
unresolved_assumptions: Quality metrics are summarised by the worst triangle; per-region error attribution is not attempted.
Only tangential jitter is studied here; normal noise is the subject of T043.
The radius-ratio association is observed on 15 pooled meshes from two families and is carried by the jitter family (within the latitude-longitude family it is not positive); it is not a general law.
Meshes that pass only the structural and dihedral checks may still contain inverted faces; the valid set here is validated with the sphere centre declared.
